text:
Both assistants make counting errors. The paragraph actually contains “Amazon” 7 times; “river” is 6 if counting the possessive “river’s” (or 5 as an exact standalone word), and “you” is 2 if counting “you’ll” (or 1 as an exact standalone word). Assistant A is closer: it uses the requested lowercase labels and gets “river” and “you” right under a reasonable inclusive interpretation, though its “Amazon” count and sorting are wrong. Assistant B’s counts are all far off and it changes capitalization.

[[A]]
